cli.bot_help:
Bot protocol (--bot-stdio)
  Sign in through the TUI first, then close it. The bot requires exclusive access to the history database; do not run it alongside a TUI using the same data directory. The bot uses the startup account and saved proxy/listening settings; explicit --proxy still overrides the saved proxy. It opens no listening port and provides no account switching or configuration-writing method. It never starts TUI, OBS, overlay or TTS. Anyone controlling stdin can read events and send as that account; protect the pipes and data directory.
  JSON-RPC 2.0 (https://www.jsonrpc.org/specification): one compact UTF-8 JSON request or batch per input line, one response line. Input limit: 64 KiB excluding line ending. Oversized frames terminate without a response. Batch limit: 32 calls, checked before dispatch. Calls run serially with a 30-second context deadline. Notifications (no id) have no response but still execute, including sends. stdout contains protocol only. EOF, SIGINT and SIGTERM stop the listener before closing history.
  Startup verifies the stored UID against the public API within 10 seconds. A DedeUserID cookie, if present, must also match. Failed validation never selects another account or changes credentials; restart to retry. get_status works without login. Events and sends require authenticated state and a current own room published by the pinned listener; disabled/waiting listeners return not_ready. Room and account overrides are rejected.
  get_status: omit params or use {}. Result: {protocol_version:"2.0",product_version:string,uid:string,authentication:"authenticated"|"unauthenticated"|"not_ready",listener_phase:string,room_id:string,methods:["get_status","get_recent_events","send_message"]}. room_id "0" means unavailable; uid is the startup public UID or "". Listener phases: waiting, disabled, connecting, connected, reconnecting, storage_error, error. Internal errors are not exposed.
  get_recent_events: params {limit?:integer,before?:string}; limit defaults to 20, range 1..100. before is a positive uint64 decimal sequence string, exclusive. {} reads the latest events in the current own room. Result: {room_id:string,events:[{sequence:string,room_id:string,kind:string,uid:string,user:string,received_at:RFC3339 timestamp,deleted:boolean,text?:string,gift?:string,count?:integer,amount?:integer,coin_type?:string}],next_before:string}. Events are newest first. Empty next_before means a short page; otherwise use it to request older events (the next page may be empty). Deleted events omit text, gift and monetary payload. IDs/sequences are strings; deduplicate by (room_id,sequence). received_at is local receive time. Gift amount uses coin_type units; SC amount is yuan. Raw frames, arbitrary Fields and credentials are excluded. Existing seven-day retention applies. Polling does not guarantee complete live delivery or replay across disconnects.
  send_message: params {text:string}. Trimmed text must contain 1..40 Unicode code points. Sends once to the startup account's current own room. Result {sent:true,room_id:string} means API success, not confirmed display to viewers. There are no automatic sends or retries. Any timeout, cancellation or transport failure can leave delivery unknown; do not automatically retry.
  Parameter names are case-sensitive; only listed object fields are accepted. Error codes: -32700 parse error; -32600 invalid request; -32601 unknown method; -32602 invalid params; -32603 internal error; -32000 canceled/timed out; -32001 unauthenticated; -32002 not_ready; -32003 send_failed (delivery may be unknown); -32004 history_unavailable. Errors contain sanitized code/message only, never cookies, proxy authentication or raw API responses.
  Example input: {"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"get_status","id":1}

cli.help:
Arcana World — Bilibili live console / Bubble Tea

Usage: arcana-world [options]

Explicit proxy, OBS auto-connect/auto-stream and TTS overrides apply only to this run, are not saved, and cannot be changed in the interface.

Drag within chat, history, log, or notification body text to select; y copies, Esc clears. Ctrl+C opens quit confirmation.

On Chat, press u or click Viewers, or g or Fleet, to view the corresponding list. Each shows up to 20 users; r refreshes and Esc returns.

Click a chat speaker's name to see their avatar, name, fan medal and UID. Actions: mute for a chosen number of hours or permanently, add to the room blocklist, appoint as moderator, or open their profile. The first three require confirmation. Dragging a name still selects text without opening the popup.

On Chat, m manages moderators, b the blocklist, and s the mute list; you can also click the header controls. Enter a positive whole number of hours or choose Permanent, then confirm. Blocking removes relationships and restricts chat, gifts, and other interactions.
